'''New Adasta''' was the capital city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the original seat of the old [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and a major commercial, political, and population center of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith]]. A metropolitan [[City/Legends|city]], New Adasta was constructed atop a rocky crag in the tundra of Ziost, and the city's [[Central District (Ziost)|Central District]] was in fact located in the cave underneath that crag. The centerpiece of the city was the [[People's Tower]], a large skyscraper similar in design to the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]], the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] focused a significant portion of his attention and power to New Adasta as he possessed the population of the planet.

==History==
New Adasta was constructed by the Sith sometime between the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and the [[Great Galactic War]], during a period of Sith recolonization, when the empire reclaimed many of its holdings lost during the former conflict. Over the years, it grew into a major city, thus replacing the planet's [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|former capital]] and becoming the primary Sith hub in the border regions of [[Seat of The Empire|Imperial Space]]. While the [[Kaas City|new capital of the Sith Empire]] was now located on the jungle world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the construction of the city restored much of the planet's former significance.

But, aside from being merely a strategic colony on the border, New Adasta was also one of the largest trade hubs in the Empire, [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from all over flocking to the business districts throughout the town. To that end, it was revered as one of the most significant economic centers in the whole Empire, even earning the planet the nickname, "the Gateway to the Empire."

At some point, the headquarters of the [[Ministry of Logistics]] relocated to the metropolis, its [[Minister of Logistics|minister]] setting up an office at the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]], which functioned as the planetary capitol.

The city also contained the Empire's primary customs office and at least one [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]].

In [[3640 BBY]], [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Theron Shan]] and Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] visited the city during [[Operation End Game]], where the former, with the help of his friend [[Teff'ith]], succeeded in stealing a [[black cipher]] from Minister [[Davidge]]'s safe in the heavily guarded Orbital Command Center. With the cipher, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] could easily conduct [[Spy/Legends|counter-espionage]] against [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:New_Adasta_concept_art.png|thumb|250px|New Adasta]]
New Adasta first appeared in the 2012 novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''. The city was never officially given a proper name, referred to only as "Ziost" in the novel. It was later featured in Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor, which gave the city a proper name; Facebook posts by the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' official account confirmed the two as being the same by quoting Gnost-Dural's description of the city.
